key_results: Stage I is reported as self-similar across studied M_s. In Stage II, RTP and SIE modes depend on droplet diameter relative to the preferred KH wavelength, not We alone.
Representative cases span M_s=1.12–1.83, We=44–1.4×10^4, Re=2.5×10^3–1.3×10^5, with RTP or SIE labels.

mechanisms.summary: Authors attribute SIE to KH instability and RTP to RT instability when KH development is unfavorable; the transition uses D_i versus λ_KH.

evidence_candidates.claim: Shock-induced aerobreakup is described in two stages: early wave dynamics followed by airflow-driven breakup.
RTP can persist to We near 800 for small droplets, while SIE can occur near We 200 for larger droplets.
